name: Oversized Mesh Jersey Top, Pink Leopard 28
description: Pink mesh jersey top with a black V-neck, a leopard-print 28 across the chest, white stripes on the sleeves and small bow prints on the sleeves. Oversized V-neck fit with half sleeves. The supplier describes the top as washable, quick-drying and breathable. Sizes are assumed, not from a size chart: if you are between sizes, go one up.

source.notes: Supplier title: 2026 Cross-Border Washable Printed Hot Girl Outfit, Collectible Quality, Must-Have Summer Item, Quick-Drying and Breathable. Price tiers: ¥20 for 1+ (screenshot ≈₦4,450.41), ¥18 for 100-999 (≈₦4,005.37), ¥16 for 1000+ (≈₦3,560.33); unit_cost is the ¥20 regular price. 2 coupons off at ¥25 spend shown, not used. Listing has 20 styles (screenshot shows 15/20); only 15 photographed styles were supplied, 10 chosen here. Same supplier as bainb-ridge-mesh-jersey-tee (Shangrao Omans Clothing Co., Ltd., 3 years on 1688). Store return rate not shown. Quick-drying is the supplier's claim, not verified. ASSUMED: sizes S-3XL (owner's choice) and the go-one-up line (no size chart given); fabric, fibre and weight unknown ('mesh' from photos). Photos are 800x800 supplier shots with white side bands; photo area cropped out (x 102-698) to 4:5 and enlarged ~2x (soft). Left out of this range: e20bf297, 409db06f, 4d62d820, black 28 "Stay Strong" and black/red 14 "Only Boy" (reasons in the combined first draft; owner approved the 10 styles). RISKS: small crests/patches (shield 'A', 'SPORT', USA star, flag patches) are generic and could not be matched to a real team or brand; not named in copy. Brown star patches on the white/brown leopard New York shirt look team-like: owner to judge. The 07 style also exists cropped (supplier screenshot, pink body); no clean photo supplied. Style: Pink Leopard 28, source photo bea7739a. Price raised from NGN 15000 to NGN 18500 on 13 Nov 2026 (owner: every price carries its freight and card fee and keeps 45%; weight-based freight estimate).
